actions.reason: K8_C0001 has an interpretable biological identity (coordinated down-regulation of oxidative phosphorylation and related mitochondrial/adipogenic/fatty-acid programs) supported by a target-specific set-scope biological_support report. Its exact-set membership_representation report is conflicting: WXS shows strong positive separation while CT, RNA, and WSI do not support the current label. Because membership is materially conflicting across modalities, isolated favorable WXS separation cannot be converted into positive membership support, so accept is not justified.

K8_C0002 has an interpretable immune-low/oxidative-metabolism-high biological identity, but its exact-set membership_representation report is weak and largely non-supportive (CT and WSI negative, RNA weakly negative, WXS near-zero, no modality positively separating). The plausible neighboring pair K8_C0002-K8_C0003 was reviewed: boundary_representation is coherent but weak across all four views, and boundary_structure shows a clearly represented boundary (ARI 0.871, within-side affinity 0.399 > between-side 0.173) with the union dominated by a single-cluster resolution. The boundary is well represented, so merge is not supported and no structural rescue remains; independent retention is unsupported.

The plausible neighboring pair K8_C0002-K8_C0003 was reviewed: boundary_representation is coherent but weak, and boundary_structure shows a clearly represented boundary (ARI 0.871) with a single-cluster union, so merge is not supported. No structural rescue remains and independent retention is unsupported.
